Metadata.InquiriesOrToReportAnIssue: If you would like to know more about how Skin Analytics can help you and your dermatology team deliver best in class dermatology, get in touch via the website.
Metadata.RegulatoryApprovalStatusIfApplicable: Skin Analytics' DERM is a Class III CE marked AI as a Medical Device (AIaMD) [1].
Metadata.Summary: Skin Analytics' DERM (Deep Ensemble for the Recognition of Malignancy) is an AI as a Medical Device (AIaMD) built around a custom teledermatology platform designed to triage patients and conserve dermatologist capacity, and is deployed in the NHS.
Metadata.Keywords: skin cancer; teledermatology; artificial intelligence; triage

UsesAndDirections.IntendedUseAndWorkflow: DERM is intended to triage patients into the right place at the right time, conserving dermatologist capacity. It safely triages patients with non-cancerous lesions away from cancer pathways, allowing dermatologists to focus on patients that need them most. It can be used in NHS Primary and Secondary Care.
UsesAndDirections.PrimaryIntendedUsers: Dermatologists, dermatology teams, and healthcare professionals in primary and secondary care settings.
UsesAndDirections.TargetedPatientPopulation: Patients referred for dermatology assessment, specifically those with suspected skin lesions.

TrustIngredients.OutcomesAndOutput: Triages patients into the right place at the right time, conserves dermatologist capacity, avoids urgent suspected cancer referrals and face-to-face USCRs.
TrustIngredients.TypeAndValueOfSolutionOutput: Triage of patients with non-cancerous lesions away from cancer pathways, allowing dermatologists to focus on the patients that need them most.
